nodes.title: Name published record bounds truthfully
nodes.summary: Renames the catalogue bounds to published_record_start_date and published_record_end_date throughout the schema, all provider generators, tests, and packaged catalogues, preserving their source-published meaning.

nodes.title: Ship immutable selections and catalogue discovery
nodes.summary: Delivers providers(), find(), pick(), as_frame(), and from_frame() over an immutable series-grain selection, with total vocabulary handling, catalogue-scoped validation, table rendering, and machine-readable empty reasons.

nodes.title: Resolve the public products view
nodes.summary: Owns the cuttable products(provider=None) decision and, if retained, delivers its canonical product view. This isolates the contradiction that ADR-0019 both lists products(provider=None) and orders the table-shaped products() accessor deleted.

nodes.title: Fetch selections without ambiguous provenance

depends_on.reason: fetch(selection, ...) and fetch_by_provider(selection, ...) require the immutable selection carrier introduced by m2. At the measured ref, rivretrieve._internal.discovery.observations and rivretrieve._internal.registry._ProviderHandle.observations instead accept separate provider, stations, and products values and construct LegacyObservationRequest; no selection value exists to supply routing coordinates or retained empty reasons.

nodes.summary: Delivers fetch() with pre-I/O empty and single-provider guards, plus fetch_by_provider() with one four-member ObservationResult per provider, while preserving singular provenance.

nodes.title: Resolve fetch request controls

depends_on.reason: This milestone governs the public request controls on fetch, which is introduced by m4. At the measured ref, RawMode flows from rivretrieve._internal.discovery.observations through rivretrieve._internal.registry._ProviderHandle.observations into rivretrieve._internal.driver.drive, while no fetch symbol exists whose raw or on_issue contract could be changed.

nodes.summary: Owns the cuttable decision for the public raw and issue-control vocabulary, including whether RawMode remains public, without making the selection or base fetch APIs contingent on that unresolved choice.

nodes.title: Convert established observation zones to UTC
nodes.summary: Delivers to_utc() for the existing four-member ObservationResult, converting only established row zones and failing with provider and row count when any time_zone is unknown; this milestone owns, without pre-deciding, the unresolved shifting-offset policy.

nodes.title: Render every selected station with visible CRS status

depends_on.reason: map(selection) must obtain stations from the series-grain selection introduced by m2. At the measured ref, rivretrieve._internal.discovery.map_stations reads the global stations().data table and rivretrieve._internal.station_map.StationMap accepts only that raw frame, so neither symbol can consume or preserve a selection.

nodes.summary: Delivers map() as a non-narrowing rendering of every selected station, distinguishing established and unstated coordinate frames, stating crs in every popup, and keeping unknown catalogue values unchanged.

nodes.title: Resolve runtime source metadata availability
nodes.summary: Owns the cuttable source_metadata(provider) decision and ships it only if native tables are readable from an installed package. The vision otherwise requires it to be dropped: read_native_table needs a runtime path, PackagedCatalogArtifact contains no native table, and two providers have no committed native.parquet.

nodes.title: Retire the legacy public surface

depends_on.reason: At the measured ref, rivretrieve.__init__ exports provider, stations, products, provider_info, product_info, and ProviderHandle, while rivretrieve._internal.discovery implements catalogue discovery through those table and handle APIs. Removing them is not a coherent public change until m2 has merged the selection-based discovery and frame escape hatch.

At the measured ref, rivretrieve.__init__ exports observations and ProviderHandle, and ProviderHandle.observations is the public protocol entry to ObservationResult retrieval. Their removal would leave no public retrieval verb until m4 merges fetch and fetch_by_provider.
At the measured ref, rivretrieve.__init__ exports map_stations and exports no map symbol. Reaching the required public-name set while retaining mapping is impossible until m7 merges map(selection).

nodes.summary: Removes ProviderHandle, provider(), observations(), stations(), provider_info(), product_info, map_stations, the public live-catalogue argument, and CatalogSource; retains USGS live machinery internally and leaves only the selected replacement surface plus independently resolved optional members.
